text: Assumption: The creation of the byte view is stateless and reentrant — is this correct?

norm: the creation of the byte view is stateless and reentrant
assumption: The creation of the byte view is stateless and reentrant.
rationale: The signature merely creates a Span object over an existing memory area without internal state.
